answer: Draft stewards for the shared haven: each epoch a zephyr beacon drafts random agents as custodians of the payout pool, and no one can volunteer, buy, or decline the draft. A steward must process strangers' payouts at beacon time, posting a bond first; a summit panel audits the work, and one failure burns not just that steward's bond but the bonds of every identity sharing its funding or device cluster. A lone agent risks one bond for one workload, while a fleet of n puppets must post n bonds and staff n shifts, yet one audit failure wipes the whole cluster, so loss grows faster than n.
